speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: That cannot be right; Pyelonephritis is a kidney infection and does not present with itchy red bumps. Based on the history of intense itching and the specific pattern of linear lines with three red papules ("the sign of three") on your thigh, I suspect scabies or insect bites despite the initial negative scraping. Please describe if anyone else in your household is experiencing similar symptoms, and tell me if you have noticed any burrows or tunnels on your skin.
